name: Telangana Tourism Rural Tourism Complex Dining
area: TSTDC Rural Tourism Complex, Bhoodan Pochampally
signature_dish: Local Telangana meals served on request to staying guests
why_it_matters: The dining at Telangana Tourism's Rural Tourism Complex in Bhoodan Pochampally — the ikat-weaving village world-famous for its Pochampally saris. The complex (four rooms and two dorms) is the only place to stay in the village, and meals are provided on request. In a village with almost no commercial restaurant, this is the genuine on-site option.
insider_tip: Meals are on request — arrange them in advance with the complex, especially if you are not staying overnight. The complex sits inside the weavers' colony, so you can pair a meal with watching ikat looms at work. For more dining choice, base in Bhuvanagiri or Hyderabad.
signature_address: TSTDC Rural Tourism Complex, Bhoodan Pochampally, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508284

name: Red Bucket Biryani (Bhoodan Pochampally)
area: Opposite Pochampally Handloom Market, Bhoodan Pochampally
why_it_matters: The Bhoodan Pochampally outlet of the Telangana biryani brand Red Bucket Biryani — sitting opposite the Pochampally Handloom Market, rated 4.3 across 365-plus reviews. In an ikat village with very little commercial dining, it is the most reliable proper biryani option right in Pochampally itself.
insider_tip: The closest dependable biryani to the weaving cluster — opposite the Handloom Market, so easy to fold into a sari-shopping visit. Biryani is the whole menu; strong takeaway operation. Walk-in.
signature_address: Opposite Pochampally Handloom Market, Nalgonda Main Road, Bhoodan Pochampally, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508284

name: Highway 9 Restaurant (Choutuppal)
why_it_matters: A long-running highway restaurant on NH-65 at Choutuppal, about 2km from the town opposite Suryodaya Mill — the Hyderabad-Vijayawada corridor that travellers use to reach the Pochampally area. With over 2,000 Justdial reviews, it is a well-established road-meal stop serving highway and local customers.
insider_tip: A Choutuppal base/highway option for a Pochampally day trip — the fried rice and chicken tikka masala are commonly praised. Multi-cuisine menu, meal for two around ₹350. Walk-in, highway parking.
signature_address: NH-65, opposite Suryodaya Mill, Lingojigudem, Choutuppal, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508252

name: Red Bucket Biryani (Choutuppal)
why_it_matters: The Choutuppal outlet of Telangana biryani brand Red Bucket Biryani — opposite the Choutuppal bus stand beside an HP petrol pump. Listed here as a base/highway option: Choutuppal is the nearest town with established dining on the NH-65 route used to reach the Pochampally ikat village.
insider_tip: A Choutuppal base/highway pick for the Pochampally day trip — biryani only, strong takeaway. Opens around noon; easy to spot opposite the bus stand. Walk-in.
signature_address: Opposite Bus Stand, beside HP Petrol Pump, Choutuppal, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508252
